title: This Is the Way
traveler_why: Tonight turns on the pause before a choice, and Wren the Wonderer is the Traveler who stops instead of rushing — she got quiet over a box of new crayons, felt a gentle nudge that sharing was the good way, and found exactly what Isaiah 30:21 promises: a voice behind you at the moment of the turn.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she gets quiet and listens with her heart. In Wren’s world today: Wren wasn’t sure whether to share her new crayons or keep them all to herself. Instead of rushing, she got quiet and thought about what was kind. In the calm, she felt a gentle nudge in her heart: sharing is the good way. She shared, and it felt right. Just like Isaiah said we hear “this is the way” when we’re quiet and trusting, Wren listened and found the good path.
